title: OpenAI Dissolves Security Team, Security Functions Merged into Existing Business Departments

content_html:
According to a report by the Financial Times on August 17, OpenAI officially disbanded its Prevention Team at the end of last month. The team was originally responsible for assessing whether frontier models posed serious risks such as bioweapons or cyberattacks, and developing corresponding mitigation strategies. After the disbandment, its functions were split according to risk areas such as biological and cyber threats, and integrated into existing business teams.

This is the latest move in OpenAI's recent organizational restructuring. Over the past few years, the company has successively disbanded the AGI Preparedness Team and the Super Alignment Team, gradually moving away from its early public governance structure that emphasized safety. At the same time, key personnel in critical safety positions such as Ethics Lead Chloé Bakalar, Chief Futurist Josh Achiam, and Head of Security Johannes Heidecke have recently left the company. Jan Leike, the former head of the Super Alignment Team who left in 2024, told the Financial Times that the company is systematically neglecting safety investments in pursuit of "cool products."

After the disbandment of the Prevention Team, Dylan Scandinaro, the newly appointed head of the Preparedness Team who joined OpenAI from Anthropic in February, will focus on researching the potential impacts of "recursive self-improving" AI. These series of changes have occurred at a crucial moment when OpenAI is preparing for a large-scale IPO, and the company's governance structure is accelerating its transition from a non-profit-led model to a commercial entity, with the tension between safety and growth remaining a focal point of external attention.

content_html_zh:
据英国《金融时报》8月17日报道，OpenAI于上月底正式解散了预防团队。 该团队最初负责评估前沿模型是否会带来生物武器或网络攻击等严重风险，并制定相应的缓解策略。 解散后，其职能根据生物和网络威胁等风险领域进行了拆分，并整合到现有的业务团队中。

这是OpenAI近期组织架构调整的最新举措。 过去几年，该公司先后解散了AGI准备小组和超级对齐小组，逐渐摆脱了早期强调安全的公共治理结构。 与此同时，道德主管 Chloé Bakalar、首席未来学家 Josh Achiam 和安全主管 Johannes Heidecke 等关键安全职位的关键人员最近离开了公司。 2024 年离职的超级联盟团队前负责人简·雷克 (Jan Leike) 向英国《金融时报》表示，该公司为了追求“酷产品”而系统性地忽视了安全投资。

预防小组解散后，二月份从 Anthropic 加入 OpenAI 的新任命的准备小组负责人 Dylan Scandinaro 将专注于研究“递归自我改进”人工智能的潜在影响。 这一系列变化发生在OpenAI准备大规模IPO的关键时刻，公司治理结构正加速从非营利主导模式向商业实体转型，安全与成长之间的紧张关系仍是外界关注的焦点。
